```
['create a BaseLLMException with status code, error message, and optional response body for LLM API errors', 'test the BaseConfig.validate_environment method to verify provider environment and required keys', 'build a BaseConfig subclass that transforms litellm-style request params into provider-specific API payloads', 'refactor the BaseConfig.transform_response method to parse raw httpx responses into ModelResponse objects', 'review the BaseConfig._add_response_format_to_tools method for converting response_format into tool calls']

```
